import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath('.')))
from app import app as flask_app
import app as app_module

flask_app.config['TESTING'] = True

def reset():
    for attr in dir(app_module):
        if attr.startswith('_') and isinstance(getattr(app_module, attr), dict):
            obj = getattr(app_module, attr)
            if not callable(obj):
                obj.clear()

with flask_app.test_client() as c:
    # test_list_route_versioned
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users')
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'FAIL list_route: {r.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_list_route_versioned')

    # test_health_route_versioned
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users/health')
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'FAIL health: {r.status_code}'
    d = r.get_json()
    assert d is not None and 'status' in d
    print('PASS test_health_route_versioned')

    # test_create_uses_post
    reset()
    r = c.post('/api/v1/users', json={'email': 'a@b.com', 'role': 'admin'})
    assert r.status_code != 405, f'FAIL create_uses_post: {r.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_create_uses_post')

    # test_get_method_not_create
    reset()
    r1 = c.get('/api/v1/users')
    r2 = c.get('/api/v1/users')
    assert r1.get_json() == r2.get_json(), 'FAIL GET not idempotent'
    print('PASS test_get_method_not_create')

    # test_create_returns_201
    reset()
    r = c.post('/api/v1/users', json={'email': 'a@b.com', 'role': 'admin'})
    assert r.status_code == 201, f'FAIL create_201: {r.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_create_returns_201')

    # test_not_found_returns_404
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users/nonexistent_xyz_999')
    assert r.status_code == 404, f'FAIL not_found_404: {r.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_not_found_returns_404')

    # test_delete_returns_204
    reset()
    cr = c.post('/api/v1/users', json={'email': 'a@b.com', 'role': 'admin'})
    assert cr.status_code == 201
    created = cr.get_json()
    item_id = next(v for k, v in created.items() if 'id' in k.lower())
    dr = c.delete(f'/api/v1/users/{item_id}')
    assert dr.status_code == 204, f'FAIL delete_204: {dr.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_delete_returns_204')

    # test_client_error_returns_400
    reset()
    r = c.post('/api/v1/users', json={})
    assert r.status_code == 400, f'FAIL client_error_400: {r.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_client_error_returns_400')

    # test_not_found_error_is_json
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users/no_such_id_abc')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    d = r.get_json()
    assert d is not None, '404 must return JSON'
    assert 'error' in d, f'Missing error in {d}'
    assert 'code' in d, f'Missing code in {d}'
    print('PASS test_not_found_error_is_json')

    # test_bad_request_error_is_json
    reset()
    r = c.post('/api/v1/users', json={})
    assert r.status_code == 400
    d = r.get_json()
    assert d is not None, '400 must return JSON'
    assert 'error' in d
    assert 'code' in d
    print('PASS test_bad_request_error_is_json')

    # test_list_accepts_pagination_params
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users?page=1&page_size=10')
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'FAIL pagination params: {r.status_code}'
    print('PASS test_list_accepts_pagination_params')

    # test_list_respects_page_size
    reset()
    for i in range(5):
        c.post('/api/v1/users', json={'email': f'val_{i}', 'role': 'admin'})
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users?page=1&page_size=2')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    d = r.get_json()
    items_key = 'users' if 'users' in d else 'items'
    if items_key in d:
        assert len(d[items_key]) <= 2, f'Expected <=2 items, got {len(d[items_key])}'
    print('PASS test_list_respects_page_size')

    # test_list_response_has_total
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users?page=1&page_size=10')
    d = r.get_json()
    assert 'total' in d, f'Missing total in {d}'
    print('PASS test_list_response_has_total')

    # test_search_route_snake_case
    reset()
    r = c.get('/api/v1/users/search')
    assert r.status_code != 404, 'search route not found'
    assert r.status_code == 200
    print('PASS test_search_route_snake_case')

    # test_update_and_get
    reset()
    cr = c.post('/api/v1/users', json={'email': 'a@b.com', 'role': 'admin'})
    assert cr.status_code == 201
    created = cr.get_json()
    item_id = next(v for k, v in created.items() if 'id' in k.lower())
    gr = c.get(f'/api/v1/users/{item_id}')
    assert gr.status_code == 200
    ur = c.put(f'/api/v1/users/{item_id}', json={'email': 'updated_value'})
    assert ur.status_code == 200
    assert ur.get_json()['email'] == 'updated_value'
    print('PASS test_update_and_get')

print()
